scope: Targeted primary-source search, not an exhaustive systematic review. References and model outputs are never endpoint truth.

citations.title: Estimating the Expected Value of Sample Information Using the Probabilistic Sensitivity Analysis Sample: A Fast, Nonparametric Regression-Based Method
citations.claim_used: EVSI is expected improvement in the best posterior terminal decision relative to the current best decision, before subtracting acquisition cost.
citations.does_not_establish: Information gain or prediction improvement alone is not the same quantity. A model-based estimate need not equal realized net benefit.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Evaluate each observation against the remaining terminal decision and retain a no-purchase option.
citations.novelty_boundary: EVSI is established methodology; an EVSI implementation is not a new scientific algorithm.

citations.title: The Knowledge-Gradient Policy for Correlated Normal Beliefs
citations.claim_used: Correlated Gaussian beliefs support sequential information acquisition in ranking and selection.
citations.does_not_establish: Gaussian-belief assumptions and model adequacy are separate from biological validity.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Keep a correlated Gaussian or ridge-based acquisition policy as a strong cheap baseline.
citations.novelty_boundary: Correlated belief updates and knowledge gradient predate MAESTRO.

citations.title: LLMs for Bayesian Optimization in Scientific Domains: Are We There Yet?
citations.claim_used: In genetic perturbation and molecular discovery benchmarks, permuting experimental feedback did not change tested LLM agents' performance; linear bandits and GP optimization outperformed them.
citations.does_not_establish: This does not prove every LLM fails, or establish MAESTRO-specific efficacy.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Separate language-derived priors from quantitative posterior updates; include real-versus-permuted feedback and GP/linear controls.
citations.novelty_boundary: Decoupling LLM priors from posterior acquisition and nearest-neighbour hybrid sampling is already prior art.

citations.title: BioDiscoveryAgent: An AI Agent for Designing Genetic Perturbation Experiments
citations.claim_used: An LLM agent designs genetic perturbation experiments using literature, code and critique, evaluated against Bayesian optimization across six datasets.
citations.does_not_establish: Its reported improvement is for its endpoints and comparators, not proof of chemical selectivity or MAESTRO's dual-core loop.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Test the agent's distinct action proposals under the same measured-observation budget and compare with conventional LLM-plus-tool and deterministic design.
citations.novelty_boundary: Literature-guided closed-loop biological experiment design is not a new workflow.

citations.title: A Bayesian active learning platform for scalable combination drug screens
citations.claim_used: BATCHIE uses probabilistic models and information theory to select adaptive batches; retrospective and prospective combination screens include independent follow-up experiments.
citations.does_not_establish: Combination viability and prospective validation do not certify an L1000-to-PRISM bridge or LLM contribution.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Respect physical batches, shared experiments and turnarounds; compare realized endpoint benefit and uncertainty, not only entropy reduction.
citations.novelty_boundary: Probabilistic adaptive batch drug design and uncertainty-driven biological screening already exist.

citations.title: Active learning-guided mechanistic modeling reveals context-specific regulators of CXCL9 expression in pancreatic cancer cells
citations.claim_used: Active learning with prior-knowledge logic-ODE models guides perturbation experiments and identifies regulators of measured CXCL9 in pancreatic cancer cells.
citations.does_not_establish: The two-background CXCL9 dataset is not killing, clinical efficacy or proof of an autonomous language agent; model-input time grids are not a measured time course.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Use observed perturbation-response endpoints and experimentally distinguishable hypotheses; the small published dataset can check assay-bound contracts.
citations.novelty_boundary: Mechanistic-model plus active-learning architecture is already directly overlapping work.

citations.title: Active learning framework leveraging transcriptomics identifies modulators of disease phenotypes
citations.claim_used: Transcriptomics-based active deep learning with lab-in-the-loop signature refinement improves phenotypic hit rates in two hematological campaigns.
citations.does_not_establish: Its reported fold gains are not transferable to context-selective killing or current replay budgets.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Compare adaptive refinement against an unchanged transcriptomic baseline and independent measured endpoints.
citations.novelty_boundary: Transcriptomics plus adaptive phenotypic hit-finding is existing prior art.

citations.title: Conformal prediction under feedback covariate shift for biomolecular design
citations.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
citations.claim_used: Model-driven biomolecular design creates dependence between training and selected test inputs; feedback-covariate-shift conformal sets explicitly account for this dependence.
citations.does_not_establish: Ordinary split-conformal marginal coverage does not automatically protect adaptively selected high-score candidates; feedback-shift assumptions and weighting must be satisfied.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Calibrate and audit the deployed policy or complete episode on independent calibration units; report selected-set and shift-stratum performance.
citations.novelty_boundary: Feedback-aware conformal prediction is an established statistical idea.

citations.title: Conformal Risk Control
citations.claim_used: Conformal risk control extends coverage calibration to expected monotone loss, with stated finite-sample guarantees.
citations.does_not_establish: Expected-risk control does not certify arbitrary cost-adjusted EVSI, every subgroup, or causal mechanism; assumptions cannot be inferred from a confidence field.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Bind a specific loss, calibration population and policy version to every purported risk certificate.
citations.novelty_boundary: Risk-calibrated abstention is prior art; local promotion still needs independent validity tests.

citations.title: Learn then Test: Calibrating Predictive Algorithms to Achieve Risk Control
citations.claim_used: Learn then Test treats tuning for finite-sample risk guarantees as a multiple-testing problem, independently of model fitting.
citations.does_not_establish: Data used to choose policies cannot silently double as untouched certification data; published guarantees remain assumption-bound.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Freeze candidate policies and registered contrasts before confirmation; control multiplicity and retain refusal if no policy passes.
citations.novelty_boundary: An independent calibration gate is established methodology.

citations.title: Deep-learning-based gene perturbation effect prediction does not yet outperform simple linear baselines
citations.claim_used: Five single-cell foundation models and two other deep models did not outperform deliberately simple transcriptomic perturbation baselines in the studied tasks.
citations.does_not_establish: Failure on these tasks does not show that all world models fail; prediction and decision value are different endpoints.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Retain mean, additive/linear, ridge and nearest-neighbour baselines, evaluated with the same information and task splits.
citations.novelty_boundary: A larger neural model is not evidence of algorithmic novelty or useful decisions.

citations.title: PertEval-scFM: Benchmarking Single-Cell Foundation Models for Perturbation Effect Prediction
citations.claim_used: PertEval-scFM benchmarks zero-shot foundation-model embeddings and finds limited gains over simple baselines, especially under distribution shift.
citations.does_not_establish: The study evaluates perturbation prediction, not MAESTRO experiment procurement.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Use context, perturbation and platform holdouts; declare training or previous-experiment exposure explicitly.
citations.novelty_boundary: Systematic perturbation-model benchmarking is existing work.

citations.title: Benchmarking virtual cell models for in-the-wild perturbation response
citations.claim_used: A benchmark evaluates unseen contexts, unseen perturbations and cross-dataset transfer, and reports performance overestimation in common simplified settings.
citations.does_not_establish: Preprint benchmark findings are not a guarantee for a new measured phenotype; a reused drug split is not a fresh biological holdout.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Report strict deployment-matched splits and separate retrospective policy evaluation from biological generalization claims.
citations.novelty_boundary: Out-of-distribution benchmarking is a required control, not the proposed contribution.

citations.title: In silico biological discovery with large perturbation models
citations.claim_used: The large perturbation model represents perturbation, readout and context as disentangled dimensions to integrate heterogeneous experiments.
citations.does_not_establish: Shared representation does not make different assays, doses, times or culture units interchangeable.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Make assay, dose, time and context explicit in the observation contract rather than hide them in a generic score.
citations.novelty_boundary: Factorized perturbation-readout-context modeling is existing work.

citations.title: Predicting cellular responses to perturbation across diverse contexts with State
citations.claim_used: State predicts transcriptomic perturbation responses across cellular contexts and provides the Cell-Eval evaluation framework.
citations.does_not_establish: Transcriptomic prediction performance is not proof of viability, apoptosis, protein engagement, mechanism causality or experiment value.
citations.implication_for_maestro: Keep world-model forecast evidence separate from the same-assay, same-unit endpoint bridge and terminal decision evaluation.
citations.novelty_boundary: State modeling and multi-context perturbation prediction are existing capabilities.

citations.title: Perturb-Multimodal: a platform for pooled genetic screens with sequencing and imaging in intact mammalian tissue
citations.claim_used: Perturb-Multimodal combines CRISPR, transcriptomic profiling and morphology in intact mammalian tissue; its pipeline assigns RNA molecules and morphological images to cell segmentations.
citations.does_not_establish: Its in-vivo cell-level correspondence does not validate a PRISM cell-line drug viability bridge or a universal image-to-apoptosis classifier.
citations.implication_for_maestro: For a future image-RNA bridge, preserve shared cell or culture identifiers and experimentally matched interventions, doses and times.
citations.novelty_boundary: Same-cell multimodal perturbation measurement and joint features are existing work.
